notes: A computed cartoon approximation and its actual orthogonal wavelet coefficients show concentration around edge curves. The signed reconstruction is not clipped before SNR measurement, and the coefficient display is explicitly logarithmic. Coefficient displays use a shared signed logarithmic grayscale with zero at mid-gray; the coarse approximation is displayed at its image intensity scale. Colored boundaries follow the actual dyadic subband slices, from red at the finest level to blue, green and purple at coarser levels. Display compression does not alter the numerical coefficients.
